definitions.explanation: A large rodent of North America and Europe with a broad flat tail, which gnaws down trees with its strong front teeth and builds dams and lodges in rivers.

examples.english: A beaver is gnawing on a tree.

examples.japanese: ビーバー⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{川|かわ}→川：02186_kawa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ダム→ダム：00034_damu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。

ビーバー⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦ダム→ダム：00034_damu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧せい⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{川|かわ}→川：02186_kawa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{流|なが}れ→流れ：03504_nagare⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わって→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧しまった。
examples.english: The dam the beavers built changed the course of the river.
